title.zh: 抛物线 · 投篮的弧线
title.en: Parabolas · The Arc of a Shot

desc.zh: 投篮的弧线就是抛物线：a 管开口方向与胖瘦；写成顶点式，顶点和对称轴直接写在式子的脸上，随着滑杆搬家；球最后落在哪里，就是图与 x 轴的交点——两个、一个，还是一个都没有，拖一拖全摆得出来。
desc.en: A basketball's arc is a parabola: a sets the opening direction and width; written in vertex form, the curve wears its vertex and axis of symmetry on its face and moves house as you drag; and where the ball lands is exactly where the curve meets the x-axis — two crossings, one touch, or none at all, every case reachable by hand.
